name: ACP Report Guard
description: Validates canonical ACP lifecycle reports and cancels malformed ones before delivery.

enforce.description: Cancel malformed lifecycle reports and block direct intermediate publication. Set false to classify and log only.

blockDirectIntermediateToolCalls.description: Block direct message-tool publication of ACP intermediate reports.

maxIntermediateChars.description: Character ceiling for the ten-minute cadence report.

maxBoundaryReportChars.description: Character ceiling for start, correction-start, and completion reports.

enforce.help: Turn off for a live message_sending cancellation smoke before activation.
